description: This file implements API endpoints for tracking user streaming statistics, including starting/stopping watch sessions and logging viewer actions and quality metrics. It uses FastAPI for defining routes under '/api/stats'.

methods.name: get_db()
methods.description: Provides a database session for dependency injection in FastAPI routes.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_user(db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a User object from the database by user ID.

methods.name: watch_start( data: WatchSessionCreate, user_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: API endpoint to start a new watching session for a user and stream.

methods.name: watch_stop( session_id: int, user_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: API endpoint to mark a watching session as ended.

methods.name: log_stat( stat: StatCreate, user_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: API endpoint to log a statistical event for a user session, such as watched seconds or quality ratings.

ctags.name: log_stat
ctags.signature: ( stat: StatCreate, user_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )

ctags.name: watch_start
ctags.signature: ( data: WatchSessionCreate, user_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )

ctags.name: watch_stop
ctags.signature: ( session_id: int, user_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
